name: decision-routing
description: [Experimental] Semantic routing with ai/decision_branch: each request goes to the smallest capable agent (email, weather, or code), each with only its own tools and prompt; ordinary, ambiguous, multi-intent, or low-confidence requests go to the general agent. Privacy: with the Jev provider the routed user request is sent to TypeSafe (hosted) on every turn. Needs a Jev credential or the deployment's JEV_API_KEY, a model on LLM Config, and mail/web tool credentials.
